messages.text: Where is my order? email (email hidden)

Trent, nothing has shipped yet, and nothing has changed since Tuesday.

Your B30 and its free Power K. (Shop····) still ship November 15, 2026. You can follow that batch on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

For your Magic M. 40T (Shop····), Magic M. expects the units to ship out from the factory today, November 12. As soon as your unit ships to you, the tracking comes to this email.

Anything else you'd like me to check?
When do you think it will ship out ?

I can't give you a date for your own 40T yet, Trent, and I won't guess one. What I know is that Magic M. expects all the units to leave the factory today, November 12. I don't have a date for when yours ships on to you. The moment it does, tracking goes to this email automatically.

If you meant the B30, that one ships November 15.
How long will shipping take for the b30 to get here ?

I don't have a confirmed delivery time from the US to Queensland, Trent, so I won't guess one. The B30 ships November 15. Once it leaves, the tracking email will show the carrier's delivery estimate, and that's the date to go by.

Would you like me to ask the team for the usual transit time to Australia?
Nah all good just been waiting a while

That's fair, Trent, and I'm sorry. You ordered the B30 back on July 24 for a September 30 ship date, and it's now November 15. That's a long wait on top of a date we missed.

The free Power K. we added in September was for that delay. It ships in the same box as your B30. Tracking for both orders will come to this email the moment each one leaves.

Thanks for sticking with us through it.

No worries, Trent. Thanks for your patience on this one.

Before you go, one quick question. You asked how long the B30 takes to reach Queensland. Is there a date you're hoping to have it running by?
